title: US inflation rises faster than expected in October as Fed weighs another rate hike
caption:
US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, above the 0.3% economists expected, with food up 0.5% and core prices also beating forecasts. It is the last inflation report before the Federal Reserve meets on December 8 and 9. Markets now expect another rate hike, and Fed governor Christopher Waller says a half-point move should be considered.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
